description.en: The United States Judo Association's ranks from 4th to 10th Dan. By 4th Dan a candidate has shown technical proficiency in the association's curriculum, and promotion from there is judged on service to the development of judo through the association rather than by examination. 4th and 5th Dan are instructor grades, 6th to 8th Dan are awarded for mastery of the curriculum and extraordinary service, and 9th and 10th Dan are reserved for a lifetime of work at national and international level. The Promotion Board, made up of 6th Dan holders and above, looks at each application as a whole, with most weight on service since the last promotion; a sub-committee reviews 4th and 5th Dan, and ranks above 8th Dan also need the approval of the Board of Directors.

beltNote.en: The forms print two colours for 4th to 8th Dan without saying how they are arranged on the belt.

source.title: Yodan to Hachidan Promotion; USJA Judo Rank Promotion System, 9th and 10th Dan Promotion Requirements; 9th and 10th Dan Recommendation for Promotion
source.date: September 2025 (4th to 8th Dan form); June 2023 (9th and 10th Dan)

note.en: Item wording is as printed, including the forms' own slips ("blackbells", "competitor, coaches" in the 9th Dan list, and "your lifetime accomplishments"). Numbering is dropped and the order kept. The forms' rank tables are flattened into items with the column headings kept. The 4th to 8th Dan form (09/2025) and the promotion page disagree in two places. The form requires sign-off by two 8th Dan holders for 7th and 8th Dan, where the page prints two 7th Dan holders; the form is transcribed. The form prints the 4th and 5th Dan belt as Red/Black and the page as Black/Red; the grade shows black with red, following the page, and 6th to 8th Dan show red with white, which both print as Red/White. The 9th and 10th Dan requirements permit a red belt or a black belt; the recommendation form and the page print red, which is shown. The recommendation form's rank table has columns for time in grade at activity levels D, C and B that are left blank, and fills only the A column (10+ and 11+); its heading is printed as "9st and/or 10th Dan". The 4th to 8th Dan form also lists sample categories the Promotion Board considers (life membership, competition, coaching, officiating, hosting events, certifications and service to the association, each at local, regional and national level). These are considerations rather than requirements and are not transcribed as items. Fees printed on the forms are not transcribed. A candidate seeking an exception to any rank requirement, including time in grade, uses the Rank Requirement Exception Request Form, which needs a two-thirds vote of the Promotion Board.

items.text: TIG: 5 years
Sign off # Rank or above: (1) 5th Dan
Mandatory requirements for promotion include current USJA membership, completion of child abuse training, concussion training, and a satisfactory background check.

Applications for promotion should include a biographical listing of accomplishments in Judo throughout an applicant’s career, with specific emphasis on service undertaken since the applicant’s most recent promotion. Accomplishments achieved through the USJA will be given the most consideration.

Must be 65 years of age or older.
Must have five continuous years closest to the date of submission as a member of USJA as a Hachidan to be eligible for promotion to Kudan.
Must be an active/current member of the USJA.
Must have been continuously involved in activities with USJA such as teaching, training, coaching, refereeing or administration/leadership.
Must be a member of a Chartered USJA club.
Must have at least 10 years in grade as a Hachidan.
Must have unquestioned moral character, integrity, and maturity. Should have an exceptional and unblemished judo career.
Must have a current & clear Background Screen, current Concussion/Heads Up Certification and Safe Sport Certification.
Must have all claimed USJA Certifications up to date and current.
Must have documented substantial National/International presence/impact/effect on the Judo Community.
Must have been an outstanding competitor, coach, referee, teacher and/or Judo leader or produced high level competitor, coaches, referees, teachers and/or Judo leaders.
A vote of 75% of the entire Promotional Committee shall be required for approval of Kudan rank.
A vote of 75% of the entire Board of Directors shall be required for approval of Kudan rank.

Must be recommended for Promotion by (2) 7D + (2) 8D + (1) 9D that are active/current USJA members with comprehensive written recommendations as to why they support this candidate for their promotion to 9D.
Must submit an extensive Judo biography to cover activities since their last promotion and your lifetime accomplishments.
Must submit an updated Photo (passport/jpg).
